records.part: 800 body-worn cameras (upgrade from Body 3)
records.reason: Axon Body 4 cameras, sold exclusively by Axon Enterprise, is the only camera which provides the necessary features and specifications required to be compatible with Axon CAD and RMS

records.part: 800 Taser 10's multi-shot conducted energy weapon
records.reason: Manufactured and available for purchase only from Axon Enterprise. Axon is also the sole distributor and retailer of all Taser brand products.

records.part: Unlimited video and data storage (3rd Party Unlimited Storage)
records.reason: Evidence.com is a secure, cloud-based digital evidence management service provided by Axon and hosted in the Azure GovCloud.

records.part: Computer Aided Dispatch system (CAD)
records.reason: The development of new RMS and CAD systems was necessary due to the prior program, Data 911, no longer supporting necessary upgrades, which were necessary to gain compliance with the National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS).

records.part: Records Management System (RMS)
records.reason: Axon RMS is also NIBRS compliant, unlike numerous other available records management systems.

records.part: Respond Plus - real-time live-streaming of body camera footage
records.reason: multiple components of the system are not offered by other providers and are solely available through Axon, including, but not limited to Respond Plus live streaming of body camera video

records.part: Draft One-Narrative Assistant AI report writing software
records.reason: Draft One artificial intelligence driven police report writing narrative assistance

records.part: My90 internal/external survey software
records.reason: This software provides the ability to conduct both internal and external surveys designed to measure efficiency in the department.

records.part: Axon Redaction software for body-worn camera video redaction
records.reason: Software used to identify and redact items from body-worn camera videos, such as selected screens, faces, license plates, and audio as required prior to release.

records.part: Community Request evidence submission portal
records.reason: Allows the agency to create an evidence submission portal for the public to submit digital evidence related to an investigation.

records.part: Standards administrative investigations/use-of-force workflow system
records.reason: Standards would replace two existing software applications currently in use: IA Pro and Blue Team.

records.part: Auto Tagging automatic digital evidence labeling
records.reason: Uses information from CAD and RMS to automatically label digital evidence (primarily body-worn camera video) in AXON Evidence.com.

records.part: Axon Performance video auditing and metrics software
records.reason: Performance randomly selects videos for auditing by supervisors on a weekly basis to ensure customer service standards are being met by officers and their actions are in compliance with department policy.

records.part: Transcription service for digital evidence audio
records.reason: Transcription is also used as the basis for Axon Draft One AI-based narrative assistance.

records.part: Signal Sidearm smart sensor for firearm holster that activates body camera
records.reason: A smart sensor, attached to a firearm holster, Axon activates an officer's body-worn camera anytime their firearm is drawn from the holster.

records.part: Axon Investigate on-prem video playback software for investigators
records.reason: Allows investigators to utilize Axon technology to playback various file formats natively.

records.part: Interview Room camera systems - unlimited storage, maintenance and licensing
records.reason: The department currently has five interview rooms equipped with Axon camera systems. This contract extends the unlimited storage, maintenance and licensing for each interview room camera.

records.part: Virtual Reality (VR) Training scenario-based training program
records.reason: Provided at no cost, this modern scenario-based training program will supplement the training and transition to the Taser 10.

records.part: FUSUS Real Time Information Center (RTIC) software integration
records.reason: Provided at no cost, this Real Time Information Center (RTIC) software integrates multiple sources of information to enhance situational awareness.

records.part: On-site Technical Account Manager (TAM) service
records.reason: Axon has agreed to continue providing an on-site TAM to the Department for no cost for years 1-3 of the contract and at 50% of the actual cost of a TAM in years 4-5.

records.part: Five-year sole source contract for purchase, maintenance and upgrade of body-worn cameras, Tasers, CAD, RMS and software
records.reason: Axon is solely qualified to meet the vast majority of technology needs for the Fresno Police Department.
